id: Re-Degradation Reveals Resolution | CVPR 2027 | addendum v4 | registered after run 3 and before run 4
scope: Frozen v1.0, addenda v2 and v3 and every rule registered so far stay exactly as they are, and the checkpoints of runs 1-3 are reused unchanged. Addendum v4 adds block B12 (the official CIFAR-10-C benchmark with six standard CIFAR-10 classifiers) with rules K1-K4, and four exploratory analyses X1-X4 of checkpoints that already exist (no pass/fail).
motivation: run 3: the plug-ins were tested on ImageNet-C corruptions re-created on our ten datasets with frozen encoders, while label-free accuracy estimation is usually reported on the official CIFAR-10-C files with classifiers trained on CIFAR-10

run 3 (observed after the fact): the plug-in applied to COTT, the strongest baseline on the corruption suite, improved COTT on the corruption suite and on SpaceNet; B12 tests this no-harm property on an independent benchmark with a rule fixed in advance
run 3: on SpaceNet MVOI the identified level grows with the off-nadir angle (V1) but ATC@s_hat does not beat ATC (V3); X2 measures how much of the off-nadir accuracy drop the identified blur explains

cifar10c.data: CIFAR-10-C (Hendrycks and Dietterich, ICLR 2019; Zenodo record 2535967, CIFAR-10-C.tar, md5 56bf5dcef84df0e2308c6dcbcbbd8499, CC BY 4.0) and the CIFAR-10 test set (Krizhevsky, 2009, binary version)
cifar10c.split: A2 = clean test images 0-4999 (source calibration); B = test images 5000-9999, one target set per corruption and severity (5,000 images); the known-corruption oracles use the corrupted copies of images 0-4999
cifar10c.order_check: the CIFAR-10-C labels must equal the test labels in every severity block
cifar10c.model_source: torch.hub chenyaofo/pytorch-cifar-models (BSD-3-Clause; trained on the CIFAR-10 training set; weights from the repository's GitHub releases)
cifar10c.predictions: the classifier's own softmax; features for the AutoEval family, NucNorm and the feature regressor = the input of its final linear layer; no probe is trained
cifar10c.source_grids: the source accuracy grid S_ACC and the AutoEval meta-set blur range are scaled by (32/224)^2 = 1/49, the same scene-relative blur as on 224-px tiles; the frozen identification (ETA_PIX, S_FIT, CAL_GRID, GOF test), NOISE_DN and the meta-set noise levels are unchanged
cifar10c.pixel_cap_note: pixel identification uses a keyed subsample of at most 2,000 images of A2 and of each target set; every estimator uses all 5,000
cifar10c.truth_level: empirical Gaussian-equivalent PSF variance per corruption and severity: weighted least squares of log g = a - s lambda / 2 over the DCT modes with 0.05 < g < 1.5, g = per-mode gain between the corrupted and the clean B images (weights = clean power); truth only, never an estimator input

K1.test: X@s_hat (v2 level) < X for the 6 plug-in pairs, one-sided Wilcoxon on paired cells (model x corruption x severity), Holm over the 6 pairs

K2.statistic: pooled MAE of COTT@s_hat (v2) minus COTT over all 95 corruption conditions and the six models
K2.ci: 95% bootstrap, corruptions resampled first, then their severities (models move together)

K3.statistic: Spearman rho between the level identified from pixels (v2) and the empirical PSF variance over the ten conditions

K4.comparison: ATC@s_hat (v2) vs the strongest baseline per corruption group and over all corruptions
K4.status: EXCEEDED / MATCHED / BELOW from the 95% bootstrap CI

exploratory.X1: plug-in matrix: MAE of X@s_hat (v2) minus MAE of X for the six plug-in pairs in every setting (B3 regimes, real shifts, B9 corruption groups, SpaceNet off-nadir views, CIFAR-10-C groups) with 95% hierarchical bootstrap CIs
exploratory.X2: SpaceNet decomposition: the accuracy drop from the 7-degree view predicted by the measured accuracy of the source re-degraded to each view's identified level (PT, v2), as a share of the true drop (views at 30 degrees or more)
exploratory.X3: fresh-subset numbers of the addendum-v2 rules P1-P4 and N1-N3, reported next to their verdicts
exploratory.X4: identification against the strongest identification method of every kind (re-blur ratio, batch matching, feature regressor, variance of the Laplacian, spectral slope) in the SOTA table
exploratory.status: exploratory: X1-X4 use run-3 checkpoints that were already analysed, so they carry no pass/fail
